rows.reason: Large collector calls subprocesses and exposes package/hardware/local config; preserve narrow installed identity/backend checks with no subprocess, paths or mutation.

Fresh-output/fake/autograd example with gradcheck and optional opcheck; no NumPy conversion, downloaded dependency or native compile.
